verdict.rationale: Lovable's first-party docs say that asking it to add login generates the signup and login pages, wires them to the backend and protects user data with row level security. The built-in Cloud backend supports sign-in by email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft and SAML SSO, so both email and social providers are covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the scaffolded auth works with social providers in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Ask Lovable to add login, and it generates the signup and login pages, wires them to your backend, and protects user data with row level security.
Manage your app's users and configure how they sign in: email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and SAML SSO, all part of the built-in backend (Cloud).
